limitations: The16fresh on-arms are the fresh sample;32paired executions are not32independent cases. Seats and pressure variants share four worlds; the20historical cases remain correlated.
New timing is restricted to source-unexposed neutral native choices; old covered references may be numeric for exposed sources, so the new domain is not a strict superset.
Exposure after source does not censor the attempt. Exposed observation counts include terminal controller observations when present; executed exposure rows are recorded separately.
Interrupted and censored phases retain elapsed lower bounds without becoming completed duration/error measurements. Contacts and nonfatal damage alone are not physical failure endpoints.

Full controls/observations/reports/sensor/upstream parity verifies diagnostic neutrality against archived historical runs and fresh timing-off arms. Fresh off/on arms share the same runtime and endpoint observer.
Historical rankers are independently fully reconstructed; fresh geometry checks only the chosen direction and current native witness, not a complete rerank.
No fitted medians, live cost admission, combat-cover policy change, enemy-flag walking claim, deployment, performance or policy-strength inference follows.

projection_and_written_claims.exposure_note: One later-exposure observation in fresh2 quiet seat1 is its unexecuted departure endpoint; exposed rows and executed rows are retained separately.
projection_and_written_claims.limits: Written local-suite and CI counts are parent-reported validation, not rerun by this read-only data audit.
